Automated Talent Intelligence Engine

An AI-assisted workflow that turns public labour-market updates, company news, role demand, and work-model signals into a weekly executive-style talent market report.

ChallengeRecruiting teams need early external signals, not only internal pipeline data.

OutcomeConverted scattered market information into clear, shareable insight for sourcing focus and workforce planning.
